integrationReview.reason: Customer-account invoice routes are guarded by CustomerAuthGuard, which validates the customer bearer token against auth-microservice; confirmed in src/common/customer-auth.guard.ts and the @UseGuards(CustomerAuthGuard) decorators on /invoices/account routes in src/invoices/invoices.controller.ts.
integrationReview.contract: POST /auth/validate token validation for customer-account invoice list and download-link rotation routes
integrationReview.configuration: AUTH_SERVICE_URL (with AUTH_INTERNAL_URL fallback), set in k8s/configmap.yaml to the in-cluster auth-microservice address on port 3370
integrationReview.failureMode: When auth is unavailable or unconfigured the guard raises an unauthorized error and customer-account routes are rejected; guarded internal routes and opaque-token document downloads keep working.
integrationReview.validation: Customer-account routes reject a request without a valid customer bearer token; guard behavior reviewed in src/common/customer-auth.guard.ts.

integrationReview.reason: The service owns the invoices PostgreSQL database via TypeORM and persists invoice documents, invoice sequence counters and invoice event records there as its durable system of record.
integrationReview.contract: Relational data model for invoice documents, annual sequence counters and processed-event idempotency records
integrationReview.configuration: DB_HOST=db-server-postgres, DB_PORT=5432, DB_NAME=invoices, DB_USER=invoices, DB_MIGRATIONS_RUN=true in k8s/configmap.yaml with DB_PASSWORD from Vault secret/prod/invoices-microservice
integrationReview.failureMode: Issuance fails closed; no invoice record is created and no invoice number is consumed when persistence is unavailable.
integrationReview.validation: Migration src/migrations/20260702120000-CreateInvoicesTables.ts applies at startup and issuance/idempotency reads and writes succeed against the invoices database.

integrationReview.reason: No Redis client, dependency or connection configuration exists in package.json, src/, .env.example or k8s/; idempotency and numbering are handled transactionally in PostgreSQL instead of a cache.
The service posts sanitized structured logs to logging-microservice via LOGGING_SERVICE_URL in src/common/logger.service.ts; this is a mandatory ecosystem capability for runtime services.
integrationReview.contract: POST sanitized structured log payloads to the shared logging-microservice endpoint
integrationReview.configuration: LOGGING_SERVICE_URL and LOGGING_SERVICE_API_PATH (default /api/logs), set in k8s/configmap.yaml
integrationReview.failureMode: Log delivery failure degrades operational visibility but never blocks invoice issuance or document delivery.
integrationReview.validation: Log emission path in src/common/logger.service.ts redacts token, secret, address, email, phone and provider payload keys before sending.

integrationReview.reason: Invoice-ready delivery is implemented in src/invoices/notifications-client.service.ts, which POSTs to /notifications/send with a bearer token and the invoice download link.
integrationReview.contract: POST /notifications/send transactional invoice-ready message carrying the document download URL
integrationReview.configuration: NOTIFICATIONS_SERVICE_URL, NOTIFICATIONS_SERVICE_TOKEN from Vault, and INVOICES_NOTIFICATION_CHANNEL_KEY (default invoices.documents)
integrationReview.failureMode: A delivery failure is caught, logged in sanitized form and returns false; the invoice stays issued and remains downloadable through its link.
integrationReview.validation: Delivery client returns false without a configured base URL, token, recipient or download URL, and the failure path is exercised by the invoice delivery flow.

integrationReview.reason: No AI client, model call, prompt path or AI_SERVICE_URL configuration exists in src/, package.json, .env.example or k8s/; invoice content is derived deterministically from the Orders snapshot.
Real payment status enrichment client code exists in src/invoices/payments-client.service.ts, which reads GET /payments/status/by-order-id using PAYMENTS_SERVICE_URL and PAYMENTS_API_KEY.
integrationReview.contract: GET /payments/status/by-order-id returning a payment snapshot used to enrich the final tax invoice
integrationReview.configuration: PAYMENTS_SERVICE_URL in k8s/configmap.yaml and PAYMENTS_API_KEY from Vault, sent as the X-API-Key header
integrationReview.failureMode: The snapshot read returns null and logs a sanitized warning; the final tax invoice is still issued without payment enrichment rather than failing.
integrationReview.validation: Enrichment path returns null when base URL, API key or applicationId is missing, confirmed in src/invoices/payments-client.service.ts.

integrationReview.reason: Invoice line items are taken from the Orders billing snapshot; no catalog client, CATALOG_SERVICE_URL configuration or product read exists in src/, .env.example or k8s/.

This service consumes Orders lifecycle events and reads the authoritative order and billing snapshot from orders-microservice; confirmed in src/invoices/orders-client.service.ts and src/events/rabbitmq-orders.consumer.ts.
integrationReview.contract: Authenticated GET /api/orders/:orderId snapshot read, plus consumption of orders.order.created.v1 and orders.order.paid.v1 as issuance triggers
integrationReview.configuration: ORDERS_SERVICE_URL in k8s/configmap.yaml and ORDERS_SERVICE_TOKEN from Vault, sent as the x-internal-service-token header with x-service-name: invoices-microservice
integrationReview.failureMode: A missing base URL or token raises ORDER_READ_CONFIG_MISSING and an invalid response raises ORDER_READ_INVALID_RESPONSE, so issuance is blocked rather than inventing order, buyer or billing data.
integrationReview.validation: Order snapshot read path and its explicit configuration/response error handling in src/invoices/orders-client.service.ts.

integrationReview.reason: Invoice issuance has no stock, reservation or fulfillment dependency; no warehouse client or WAREHOUSE_SERVICE_URL configuration exists in src/, .env.example or k8s/.
This service is the invoices domain itself, not a consumer of another invoices service.

No MinIO or S3 client, bucket configuration or upload path exists in src/, package.json or k8s/; rendered documents are persisted in the service database and PDFs are produced on demand with PDFKit. Durable object storage remains a known future item that is not yet authorized by the owner, so it is not a current integration.

The service consumes orders.order.created.v1 and orders.order.paid.v1 from the orders.events topic exchange through the durable queue invoices.orders.lifecycle; the consumer is implemented with amqplib in src/events/rabbitmq-orders.consumer.ts and both routing keys are bound.
integrationReview.contract: Consume orders.order.created.v1 and orders.order.paid.v1 from the orders.events topic exchange via the durable queue invoices.orders.lifecycle, with prefetch 1 and per-message ack/nack
integrationReview.configuration: RABBITMQ_URL, ORDERS_EVENTS_EXCHANGE=orders.events, INVOICES_ORDERS_QUEUE=invoices.orders.lifecycle and the activation switch ORDERS_EVENTS_CONSUMER_ENABLED, which the production ConfigMap currently sets to false so lifecycle-driven issuance is presently driven through the guarded synthetic ingestion route while owner-gated runtime activation is pending.
integrationReview.failureMode: When the consumer is disabled or RABBITMQ_URL is absent the service logs a sanitized warning and starts without consuming; a consume error nacks the message without requeue and the event can be replayed safely because (orderId, invoiceType) is the durable idempotency key.
integrationReview.validation: Consumer binding and ack/nack behavior in src/events/rabbitmq-orders.consumer.ts, plus replay through the internally guarded POST /invoices/events/orders route.

integrationReview.reason: The service must remain discoverable by the documentation and adoption indexing stack; this is a mandatory capability for runtime-service profiles.
integrationReview.contract: Direct Git repository ingestion and repository-scoped retrieval
integrationReview.configuration: The project is tracked by the canonical repository registry and the docs-RAG index
integrationReview.failureMode: When docs-RAG is unavailable, the repository-local intent and operation documents remain the authoritative source.
integrationReview.validation: Project documents resolve to the owning repository path and are discoverable without inventing facts.

integrationReview.reason: Runtime health and rollout readiness must be observable; this is a mandatory capability for runtime-service profiles and is confirmed by the GET /health endpoint in src/health.controller.ts.
integrationReview.contract: GET /health returning a service health payload, used by the Kubernetes readiness probe
integrationReview.configuration: Health probes defined in k8s/deployment.yaml against port 3204
integrationReview.failureMode: An unhealthy service fails readiness, blocks rollout completion and is reported to the owner.
integrationReview.validation: GET /health returns a success payload naming invoices-microservice, per src/health.controller.ts.

integrationReview.reason: The service persists invoice documents, annual numbering counters and event idempotency records as its durable system of record in PostgreSQL, and legal invoice history requires backup coverage; this is a mandatory posture for runtime services holding tax documents.
integrationReview.contract: PostgreSQL backup and retention policy covering the invoices database
integrationReview.configuration: Retention and backup schedule managed by database-server for the invoices database
integrationReview.failureMode: Loss of issuance history or numbering counters is surfaced and triaged before continued production operation, because numbering cannot be reconstructed safely.
integrationReview.validation: Backup posture for the invoices database is defined and reviewed as part of database-server operations.
